baseline_full_sample.note: recomputed in-process; must match q02 to ~1e-6

equal_n_design.design: every cell in a group subsampled WITHOUT replacement to the group's minimum raw sample count; target = IQR-mean of the DRAWN samples only

equal_n_floor.note: re-MEASURED for this design; equal-n targets are noisier so N4's floor cannot be reused

registered_verdict.verdict: INVARIANT B SURVIVES the equal-n falsifier
registered_verdict.rule: registered in ADDENDUM 2: CI95 excludes 0 AND |beta| > this design's own permutation floor => survives; otherwise falls, and the CORRECTNESS verdict then rests on the geometric-R2 nulls (P2/P3/N3) alone

placebo_permuted_freq_is_the_floor_run.note: the floor run IS the registered placebo: equal-n targets + permuted frequency
